annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/2120 renewing the designation of issuing entities designated to operate a system for the assignment of Unique Device Identifiers (UDIs) in the field of medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/2120 renewing the designation of issuing entities designated to operate a system for the assignment of Unique Device Identifiers (UDIs) in the field of medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision renewing for five years (27 June 2024 to 27 June 2029) the designation of four issuing entities operating the Unique Device Identifier system for medical devices under Regulations 2017/745 and 2017/746. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Renews designation of UDI issuing entities listed in Decision (EU) 2019/939 for five years
Validity runs from 27 June 2024 until 27 June 2029
Commission found all four entities remain compliant with designation criteria
Enters into force on day of publication in the Official Journal
